description: Query and load data in Azure Data Explorer (Kusto): run read-only KQL queries with typed parameters, ingest rows inline or by streaming, write query results into tables, create and drop tables and stored functions, read schemas and table details, grant database roles, and check for failed ingestion. Works with the free cluster.
